title: Certify infinite-order growth of swapped source-code charts
body:
## Summary

```text
selected 112-port query R
  chart (A,T):       order 6
  chart (T,A):       order 6
  alternating pair: infinite order
```

Prove a scoped source-restoration obstruction for two admissible charts. Their alternating product has characteristic polynomial

```text
(t-1)^88 (t^3-171t^2+27t-1)^8
```

Its trace is 1456 and it has a real eigenvalue strictly between 170 and 171. Thus the product has infinite order over Q and Q(i).

Retain Ali Romman's [PR #1862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1862) fixed-chart construction and changing-chart warning, and David Arias's [PR #1973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1973) fixed-code winding and distinct F-B-F obstruction. The new result is the exact order and growth of this particular alternating pair. Predecessor commits and selected-source hashes are pinned in the package.

## Evidence

- Before: each fixed chart has order six; this does not establish periodic restoration after changing charts. After: the independent section decomposition and exact product polynomial certify infinite order for this pair.
- Standard and optimized registered replay pass. Each checks source pins, 336 column comparisons against an ordered-factor interpreter, four semantic failure controls and eight focused tests.
- All 45 research-workflow tests pass with no skips. Metadata, warning-enabled bytecode compilation, baseline bindings and diff checks pass.
- A fully paginated overlap refresh covered 404 open PRs and 625 Discussion records without warnings. Scope terms matched this package, its PR and its coordination claim. Coverage timestamps and limits are in `TASK.json`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/source-code-chart-order
python3.12 -I -O -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/source-code-chart-order
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Adds only `research/source-code-chart-order/`. The selected frontier, source archive and frozen predecessors remain unchanged.

The sampled `complex-new-helper-inventory` task changed scope to this source-restoration audit. It does not meet that card's new-inventory construction gate. No native route, controller admission, paid cost invoice, supplier gain or κ improvement is claimed. Full selected cold replay, hosting/precision admission and proof-assistant verification remain outside scope. Open next questions are in the package README and `TASK.json`.
